name: howtoai-dev
description: HowToAI software-development process: plan, tests first, build, test, review, human review, and deploy, with a learn loop and per-technology workbooks. Version 0.9.0 holds the foundations (dev-core and the plan-review goldfish, scorer, and verifier agents, every goldfish searching wide and marking findings outside the change, plus goldfish-compliance for the workbooks and the workspace's instruction files), dev-workbook with base workbooks for C#, .NET, Docker, and Terraform, dev-plan, the entry point that plans and gets approval for a change, dev-test, which writes tests first and runs them safely, with the dev-test-first and dev-safe-target hooks, and dev-build, which builds each work item as the smallest change that passes, every line traced to the work item, behind a lint, format, type-check, and test gate, and dev-review, which runs a goldfish code review with scored and verified findings and records your fix now, later, or decline choices, and dev-learn, which finds why serious, declined, and repeated findings got through and routes each approved fix to the lowest level that resolves it (a workbook or reference file, then a goldfish, then a skill file), and dev-deploy, which deploys to any target the user names with that target's own tools (set up on first use, with its technology knowledge in workbooks), one approval per production step with the rollback planned first, health checks, and self-edits
